verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents Vertex AI as a platform explicitly for building, scaling, and governing 'enterprise grade AI agents' and 'agentic systems at global scale,' plus first-party MCP tooling (Cloud Run MCP server, genai-toolbox) for connecting agents to cloud resources — this is more than a blog vision, it's shipped, named product surface. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on the actual runtime/orchestration mechanics (e.g., Agent Engine, session/state management, deployment lifecycle, multi-agent orchestration specifics), so the 'managed home' claim is only thinly substantiated. Missing for 10: documented agent runtime architecture/session management, orchestration framework details, and independent hands-on confirmation that agents can be deployed and run end-to-end on the platform.
